extraction_notes: Table 6 provides exact activity/selectivity/yield data at 503 K, 5.0 MPa and GHSV = 10 000 mL gcat−1 h−1 for all five catalysts. Figure 8 pressure-series values were extracted where readable; exact text values were used for CHT-Y0.1 at 0.3 and 9.0 MPa. Figure 10 stability plots contain many closely spaced time-on-stream points and were not digitized point-by-point; the text reports only percentage declines, not absolute tabulated final values.
